summary: Decision 8 pass over 40 SEC whistleblower award orders: every programme rule an order restates (Rule 21F-6(c) $5 million presumption and 30% statutory maximum, $1,000,000 sanctions threshold, 10-30% range, 60- and 90-day deadlines, 30-day Form TCR waiver, Rule 21F-4(d)(2) aggregation of proceedings of $1,000,000 or less) is now recorded from that order, quoted from it.

program_rules.notes: Stated negatively: a proceeding with sanctions below $1,000,000 does not qualify as a Covered Action in its own right. A redaction label sits inside the line in the PDF text layer.

program_rules.applies_to: later Commission proceeding from the same nucleus of operative facts with monetary sanctions of $1,000,000 or less: deemed part of the covered action for award payment (Rule 21F-4(d)(2))

program_rules.notes: Proposed rule (not in DATA_MODEL list): Rule 21F-4(d)(2) deems a later proceeding with sanctions of $1,000,000 or less, arising from the same nucleus of operative facts, part of the covered action for payment. The order quotes the rule text.

program_rules.applies_to: submitting Form TCR after first providing the information, or after notice of the requirement (automatic waiver of the TCR rules)
program_rules.quote: if he/she submits the Form TCR within 30 days of learning of the requirements
program_rules.notes: New Rule 21F-9(e) in the amendments adopted 23 Sep 2020; the order says they "will become effective 30 days after publication in the Federal Register" and prints no date, so valid_from is left empty. The order also says claimants with counsel are deemed to have constructive notice and are not entitled to the automatic waiver.
